'''Xim's Royal Palace''' was one of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the despot's]] royal palaces. It was located on [[Argai]], and was probably built around [[25,130 BBY]] when Xim came to power.

This palace was still standing when Argai became loyal to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and when they joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
